save_quantized_model_as_autoround: save a quantized PyTorch model in auto-round format to a specified output directory with tokenizer and processor
pack_model_layer_for_quantization: pack a model layer for quantization by replacing it with a QuantLinear layer using the specified backend
import_quant_linear_for_backend: dynamically import the correct QuantLinear class for a given backend like auto_round, gptq, or awq
pack_lowbit_activation_layer: pack a model layer with 8-bit or lower activation quantization using Triton-based QuantLinear
review_quantization_export_functions: review the export module functions for packing and saving quantized models in auto-round format
